description: A3 task 9 (F7; #732): Warm-up and Cooldown from real data, coaching and movement notes, wired through Round 7's owners. Guides (TASK-022, TASK-034): Round 7's PreparationGuide (src/ui/preparation-guide.tsx, gallery bec4454) draws TASK-034's reading (src/state/preparation-guide.ts) on /review (composedPreparationGuide, in each section's place), /workout and /history/:id (persistedPreparationReading over the session's active rows, swaps in place), in its loading, error-with-retry, missing and ready states; the gallery's sample guides reach no route. Clock (TASK-022): the session's PreparationClockProvider holds each section's clock (usePreparationClock) in Round 7's CountdownBar, Start / Pause and Add 30 sec, no Dismiss, its warning read from its own deadline (movementCountdownDeadline). Coaching (TASK-005, TASK-045): GroupExerciseCoaching keeps the hidden '— FORMAT: names' suffix, a role=group section per movement labelled by its heading (aria-labelledby) and HeadingSection levels; the movement note opens Round 7's 'Movement note' dialog from 'Add/Edit note — <movement>' with its status beside it, the draft and a failure kept; the empty-state messages stay (decision 5). check-01 runs the brief's five files whole and declares every case of the three files this task owns whole (preparation-guide, group-exercise-coaching, exercise-coaching), the carried TASK-034 state suite and the one TASK-005 coaching body it restores in Workout.test.tsx (TASK-110's; R7-1). check-02 runs only circuit-rounds' AC-061 case by name (round-07 S2, R7-5). parity compares each real route this task wires with its accepted gallery state (preparation, movement-note, cards) at 320 and 390. Every declared case must execute and pass.
